Name: Better Recycling Machine
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=3]This mod is heavily inspired by one of my favourite SDV 1.5 mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13331]Recyclable Artifacts[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/90573338]Zilchaz[/url].

Better Recycling Machine was written from scratch to work entirely, and solely with, Content Patcher for 1.6.

[b]What You Can Recycle:
[i]
(Enabled by default)
[/i][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Artifacts[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][i](Disabled by default)[/i][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Fertilizers and Soils[/size]
[*][size=3]Sprinklers[/size]
[*][size=3]Fences and Gates[/size]
[*][size=3]Signs[/size]
[*][size=3]Torches[/size]
[*][size=3]Fishing Tackle[/size]
[*][size=3]Chests[/size]
[*][size=3]Totems[/size]
[/list][size=3]All categories can be toggled on and off in the config.

Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]!
[/size][size=3]
[b]What You Get Back:[/b]
Most items have a few logical resources they will convert into in the Recycling Machine, and often the amount of that resource received will vary slightly each time to keep some amount of randomness and luck to it. For instance, recycling a gold mask will return 3-5 gold ore and recycling a wooden statue could get you wood or possibly hardwood. My hope is that variable returns will make gameplay a little more interesting.

[b]Compatibilities[/b]
Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url], which adds its own custom artifacts, and those artifacts are all recyclable because Lumisteria helpfully used similar context tags as vanilla artifacts.

Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21539]Weather Totems Expanded[/url], which adds custom weather totems, and those totems are all recyclable.

Other mods that use context tags for their custom items should also work without any direct compatibility needing to be added as I used context tags instead of item ids to hopefully increase modded item compatibility.

[b]What Cannot be Recycled:[/b]
Weapons, Tools, Rings, Clothes, and Boots cannot be recycled using this mod as the game does not treat them the same as other objects and is therefore outside the scope of what Content Patcher can handle.

As an alternative, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3782]Ship Anything[/url] to help clear out inventory space.
